scope: Read-only, post-hoc old-v3 diagnostic; no new simulation or fitting.
units: Probabilities and gains are fractions; multiply gains by 100 for percentage points.
limitations: Six lift selections are a post-hoc subgroup, not a prespecified causal partition.
Eight suffixes per source are paired replicates, not independent sources.
Old validation has only three executed arms; other candidate probabilities have no held real outcomes here.
Shared prediction error does not establish its physical contact cause or the behavior of a new continuous gradient.
This script reads no new flow study outcomes and selects no new algorithm parameter.
